answer: Admission auctions cap each epoch at 50 seats. Each applicant stakes a marble as a chip and posts a sealed bid; the top 50 win, losers get the marble back minus $2, winners lock their bid for 20 epochs. A gale of 1,000 fake identities needs 1,000 winning bids at $40 each, locking $40,000 for 20 epochs, while one honest agent pays $40 once for a full share. Winners go on a public timber board; rented reputation is exposed and the bid forfeited.
